trigger.reported_issue: Apple told the owner the App Privacy information mixed Android and Apple platform practices.
trigger.note: The call wording is owner-reported and was not independently recorded in App Store Connect.

source_scope_review.evidence_used_for_change: The cited Google Sign-In and Google Mobile Ads privacy declarations were found in a compiled iOS bundle: GoogleSignIn_GoogleSignIn.bundle/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and Frameworks/GoogleMobileAds.framework/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
source_scope_review.assessment: The direct evidence was iOS-specific, but it was insufficient to certify app-level App Privacy answers across all platforms and third-party partners. SDK manifests are declarations, not proof of complete runtime practices.

apple_documentation.rule: App Store Connect App Privacy responses are provided at app level, should accurately represent practices across platforms, and must include integrated third-party partners. Use the most comprehensive and inclusive answer where one platform collects more.

required_next_evidence: Inventory the actual data collection and sharing behavior on iOS and Android independently.
Map every collected data type, purpose, linked status, tracking status, and third-party partner to the app-level ASC answers.
Verify final iOS and Android release artifacts and relevant runtime behavior before claiming compliance.

sensitive_data: No credentials, passwords, JWTs, receipts, or reviewer login data recorded.
